title: Cosmic Barn Snatch
description: A surreal night scene featuring a large wooden barn with multiple eyes and a sign reading 'BEWARE THE BARN SNATCH'. Three winged angelic figures with halos float above the barn, while a person in white robes and a hat rides a giant ornate turtle along a glowing purple path. A large crying monkey head appears in the starry swirling sky.
